outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original tactical game walking sprite strip, EXACTLY FOUR full-body poses in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW. Image1 is the authoritative leg-articulation guide, NOT a character design: its four blue/orange skeleton phases specify the different near/far legs. Image2 is the sole identity, equipment, style and color reference. Render this SAME Seedcutter woman over each of the four guide poses, keeping torso/head facing screen RIGHT at fixed three-quarter camera, steady body height and equal scale. Convert blue near leg and orange far leg into her SAME original wrapped brown trouser legs, pale seed-shell kneepads and boots; do not retain diagram colors.
LEFT TO RIGHT: 1 near leg leads forward to screen-right, far leg trails left, both boots contact; 2 near leg supports under hip, far knee bends and boot lifts passing beneath body; 3 FAR leg now leads to screen-right while NEAR leg trails screen-left, both boots contact; 4 FAR leg supports under hip while NEAR knee bends and boot lifts. Different anatomical leg ownership, not repeated lead and not whole-body mirroring.
Identity invariant: young brown-haired woman with bun, green headband/scarf, leather/dark-olive armor and pale seed-shell shoulder/chest/knee plates, wicker backpack full of saplings and cut wood, belt rope coil and amber bottles. Anatomical RIGHT hand keeps the short brown-handled CRESCENT IRON SICKLE lowered at her side, LEFT hand keeps the same red-bound upright leafy cuttings. No swapped hands, weapons or limbs, no disappearing backpack, exactly two complete legs per pose. Preserve original quiet soft painted texture and proportions, not brighter/glossier or caricatured. Tiny stray brown fragment below image2 is NOT part of the character; omit it.
Wide single-row sheet, four equal cells and generous gaps, all sickle tips, backpack twigs and boots inside each cell, no overlap or crop. Pure flat vivid green RGB0,255,0 removable backdrop, including every gap; no green spill, floor/shadow, checkerboard, text, guide skeleton/lines, labels or effects. All four frames form one articulated walking cycle, not four standing copies.
outputs.reason: Other columns repeat lead/support; separate phase guides refine missing phases.
